aliases: 3MP Wi-Fi Solar Wire-free Pan & Tilt Network Camera

power.method: USB-C 5 VDC, 2 A; 10000 mAh / 36 Wh battery + 8 W solar module

features: wire-free 10000 mAh / 36 Wh battery + 8 W solar module, cold-weather preheat charging
Wi-Fi 6 dual-band (IEEE 802.11b/g/n/a/ac/ax 2.4/5 GHz) + Bluetooth pairing, RJ-45 ethernet
smart dual light: 30 m IR + 20 m warm light color night vision
AOV (Always-On Video) all-day recording ultra-low-power mode
AI human and vehicle detection with quick wake-up
sound and light alarm active deterrence
two-way talk (G.711a/Mu/PCM), microSD up to 512 GB, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua APOLLO P11 2K is a wire-free Wi-Fi 6 solar pan & tilt camera with a 10000 mAh battery and 8 W solar module, 2K resolution, smart dual-light color night vision, AOV low-power recording and AI human/vehicle detection with sound-and-light active deterrence. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: App-only wire-free battery/solar camera managed via the DMSS app; no ONVIF or documented RTSP path on the datasheet. Add via the Generic Camera (RTSP) integration only if a local stream is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: No confirmed local RTSP path; DMSS-managed wire-free battery camera.
